description: Finds who is actively buying in an area: properties in a zip, city or county owned by investors, grouped by owner when run. By default it looks for owners of 2+ properties who bought in this area in the last 12 months. Options: minPurchasesLast12Months keeps owners who bought at least N properties in the last 12 months. That count covers the owner's whole portfolio, not only this area, so it is the closest available measure of 'bought N+ here'; boughtWithinMonths keeps it to owners who bought here recently. corporateOnly keeps companies and LLCs. cashInvestorOnly keeps properties bought with cash by an absentee investor. outOfStateOnly keeps owners who live in another state. Each property record costs credits, the same as a national property search. Never spends credits: it counts the matches and prices one batch. Always quote first. Then tell the user the credit cost, the batch size and their balance after. Records this workspace already pulled in the last 24 hours are free. For large searches, prefer a smaller batch (limit) or narrower filters, such as a zip instead of a county. One run returns at most 250 records; page with offset. Quotes expire after 10 minutes. Call run_active_investor_search with the quote_id only after the user agrees to the credit cost.

boughtWithinMonths.description: Only properties in this area bought in the last N months. Default 12. Null means any time.

cashInvestorOnly.description: Only properties bought with cash by an absentee investor.

county.description: County name, without the word County.

limit.description: Records to price in this batch (max 250). Leave empty to let the quote pick a safe batch size.

minPropertiesOwned.description: Only owners with at least this many properties. Default 2.

minPurchasesLast12Months.description: Only owners who bought at least this many properties in the last 12 months, counted across their whole portfolio.

offset.description: Skip this many matches. Use it to quote the next page.

outOfStateOnly.description: Only owners whose mailing address is in another state.

propertyType.description: SFR single family, MFR multifamily, CONDO, LAND, MOBILE or OTHER.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. TX. Required.

zip.description: Five-digit zip code. The narrowest and cheapest place filter.

name: quote_active_investor_search
title: Quote an active investor search
